items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: With this Buz ZIN Harris thing, his wife was very jealous of me and one day he hit her in the eye.

ctx.x: Did you ever run into her?

No, I never saw her. They said she was a blonde girl, something, I don't know. They described her to me but I never even went looking for her. I was so dumb, so full of music till they called me "Dummy". I never paid attention to any danger or anything else. There was always music around, but later on I discovered that the wives were protecting me and they often would protect me. There was quite a bit of jealousy around.
